scope: Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle (2nd ed.), Chapter 4: Monetary Policy Design in the Basic New Keynesian Model, with Appendix 4.1 and Exercises 4.1-4.6. The efficient allocation and its symmetry, markup and dispersion distortions, the optimal subsidy, the divine coincidence, determinacy under the exogenous, Taylor-type and forward-looking rules (with the corrected forward-rule matrix), the second-order welfare approximation with an exact version of Lemma 2, simple rules and Table 4.1, and the exercises. Post-book: Ex 4.4(c) uniqueness under the money rule proved (the rule reduces to the Chapter 3 money-rule system with zero shocks, which is determinate).
source: Jordi Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle: An Introduction to the New Keynesian Framework and Its Applications, 2nd ed., Princeton University Press, 2015, Chapter 4, pp. 98-125.
